name: CCA 1301 刹车超温 一个前轮没气

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 301, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are parking at gate 215, you are ready for push back and start up, contact Beijing Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 301，从 Beijing 到 Guangzhou，停在 215 号登机口，准备推出和开车，联系北京地面。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1301, gate 215, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA1301，215 号登机口，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 301, Beijing Ground, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，北京地面，推出和开车批准，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头朝西，CCA1301。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已完成推出和开车，准备滑行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1301, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA1301，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 301, Beijing Ground, taxi via taxiway Yankee 4 and Golf 2, hold short of Hotel.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，北京地面，经滑行道 Yankee 4 和 Golf 2 滑行，在 Hotel 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Y4 and G2, hold short of H, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Y4 和 G2 滑行，在 H 前等待，CCA1301。

cards.audioText: B: During taxiing, you notice the Airbus 330 in front of you is leaking fluid from the right engine, report it to Beijing Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 滑行期间，你注意到前方 Airbus 330 右发漏液，向北京地面报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1301, the A330 ahead is leaking fluid from the right engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA1301，前方 A330 右发漏液。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, thank you, Air China 301, continue taxi.
B: Tell the controller that you are unable to taxi because you find the taxiway surface is contaminated with leaking fluid.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，谢谢，Air China 301，继续滑行。
B: 告诉管制员你无法滑行，因为发现滑行道表面被泄漏液体污染。
cards.referenceText: We are unable to taxi, the taxiway surface is contaminated with leaking fluid, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们无法滑行，滑行道表面被泄漏液体污染，CCA1301。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 301, roger, turn left, taxi via Yankee 1, then turn left, taxi via Yankee 2.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，收到，左转，经 Yankee 1 滑行，然后左转，经 Yankee 2 滑行。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, taxi via Y1, then turn left, taxi via Y2, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，经 Y1 滑行，然后左转，经 Y2 滑行，CCA1301。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备离场，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA1301，跑道 36R 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 301, line up and be ready for immediate departure.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，进跑道，准备立即离场。
cards.referenceText: Line up and be ready for immediate departure, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道，准备立即离场，CCA1301。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 301, runway 36R, cleared for immediate takeoff, surface wind 340 degrees, 2 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，跑道 36R，可以立即起飞，地面风 340 度，2 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared for immediate takeoff, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，可以立即起飞，CCA1301。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 301, stop immediately! I say again! stop immediately!
B: Tell the controller you use the maximum brakes and you are stopping on the runway.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 301，立即停止！我再说一遍！立即停止！
B: 告诉管制员你使用最大刹车，正在跑道上停止。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, we used the maximum breaks and we are stopping on the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA1301，我们使用最大刹车，正在跑道上停止。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 301, vacate runway via Echo 2.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，经 Echo 2 脱离跑道。
cards.referenceText: Vacate runway via E2, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 E2 脱离跑道，CCA1301。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have vacated runway 36R via Echo 2 and ask Beijing Tower the reasons for rejected takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已通过 Echo 2 脱离跑道 36R，并询问 北京塔台 中断起飞的原因。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, runway 36R vacated via E2, confirm the reasons for rejected takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA1301，已通过 E2 脱离跑道 36R，确认中断起飞原因。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 301, the landing aircraft on the short final just made the go around.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，短五边上的着陆航空器刚复飞。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CCA1301。

cards.audioText: B: Now you find your brakes are overheating, tell the controller you need 2 minutes to cool the brakes.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你发现刹车过热，告诉管制员你需要 2 分钟冷却刹车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, our brakes are overheating, we need 2 minutes to cool the brakes.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA1301，我们刹车过热，需要 2 分钟冷却刹车。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 301, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need ground services to cool the wheels.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 301，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你需要地面服务冷却机轮。
cards.referenceText: Request ground services to cool the wheels, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求地面服务冷却机轮，CCA1301。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 301, what else do you need?
B: Tell the controller 1 of your nose wheel tires was deflated, you have to hold at present position for maintenance inspection.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 301，还需要什么？
B: 告诉管制员你一个前轮轮胎泄气，必须在当前位置等待维修检查。
cards.referenceText: 1 of our nose wheel tires was deflated, we have to hold at present position for maintenance inspection, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们一个前轮轮胎泄气，必须在当前位置等待维修检查，CCA1301。

cards.audioText: B: After the check, the maintenance staff told you that your parking brakes have seized, report it to the controller.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 检查后，维修人员告诉你停车刹车卡滞，向管制员报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, our parking breaks have seized.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA1301，我们的停车刹车卡滞。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 301, what assistance do you require?
B: Tell the controller you need a tug to tow you back to the maintenance apron.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 301，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你需要拖车把你拖回维修机坪。
cards.referenceText: Request a tug to tow us back to the maintenance apron, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求拖车把我们拖回维修机坪，CCA1301。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 301, hold position, the tug will come soon.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 301，原地等待，拖车很快到。
cards.referenceText: Holding, roger, thanks, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，收到，谢谢，CCA1301。
